description.zh: 衣物求解器用的面料力学参数（国际单位制）。每个数注明来源；“derived”是由文献值换算的，“assumed”是假定值。换算：1 gf·cm²/cm = 9.81×10⁻⁵ N·m（单位宽度的弯曲刚度）；1 gf/(cm·deg) = 56.2 N/m（每弧度剪切角）；KES 拉伸到 Fm = 500 gf/cm（490 N/m）时，割线膜刚度 ≈ 490 N/m ÷ EMT。
description.en: Fabric mechanics for the clothing solver (SI units). Every number names its source; 'derived' values are converted from literature values, 'assumed' ones are assumptions. Conversions: 1 gf·cm²/cm = 9.81×10⁻⁵ N·m (bending rigidity per width); 1 gf/(cm·deg) = 56.2 N/m (per radian of shear angle); for a KES tensile run to Fm = 500 gf/cm (490 N/m) the secant membrane stiffness ≈ 490 N/m ÷ EMT.

xpbd.zh: 求解器（src/cloth/solver.ts）里：拉伸 / 剪切约束的柔度 α = 1 / (k·A)，k 为膜刚度（N/m），A 为三角形的裁片面积（m²）；弯曲用 Bergou 等（2006）的等距弯曲模型，每条内边的刚度 B / (A₀ + A₁)（这样均匀弯成圆筒时弯曲能等于板理论的 ½·B·κ²·A），B 为弯曲刚度（N·m），柔度为其倒数；XPBD 中再除以子步长的平方。质量 = 面密度 × 面积，三等分到三个顶点。厚度用作与皮肤保持的碰撞距离（不小于 2 mm）和渲染时的外移量。
xpbd.en: In the solver (src/cloth/solver.ts): stretch / shear constraints have compliance α = 1 / (k·A), k the membrane stiffness (N/m), A the triangle's pattern area (m²); bending uses the isometric model of Bergou et al. (2006), stiffness B / (A₀ + A₁) per interior edge (so a sheet bent evenly into a cylinder has the plate-theory energy ½·B·κ²·A) with B the bending rigidity (N·m), compliance its inverse; XPBD then divides by the substep squared. Mass = areal density × area, split equally over the three corners. Thickness is the collision distance kept from the skin (at least 2 mm) and the outward offset when rendering.

note.zh: 60/40 涤棉单面针织，作为棉单面针织的近似
note.en: a 60/40 polyester/cotton single jersey, standing in for cotton jersey

note.zh: 从图上读出；原文的 WT 与 Fm = 500 gf/cm 对不上，针织布的初始模量其实更低，只取数量级
note.en: read from figures; the paper's WT does not fit Fm = 500 gf/cm and a knit's initial modulus is really lower, so order of magnitude only

note.zh: 干燥皮肤上一般 0.2 以上、典型约 0.5（综述摘要）；针织取 0.4
note.en: dry skin is usually above 0.2, typically about 0.5 (review abstract); 0.4 taken for the knit

note.zh: 没有找到可核实的棉单面针织垂坠系数；检查用 Cusick 垂坠仪对一般服用面料给出的全范围 30–98 %，并要求比斜纹低
note.en: no verifiable drape coefficient for cotton jersey was found; the check uses the full 30–98 % range of the Cusick tester for apparel fabrics and requires it to be below the twill

name.zh: 纯棉斜纹 / 牛仔类机织（长裤、裙）

note.zh: 经纬向平均值，所以两向取同一个数
note.en: warp/weft averages, so both directions take the same number

note.zh: Özkan 等测得 410–430 g/m² 弹力牛仔布 DC 89.8–94.2 %（TS 9663）；我们的布更轻、无弹性纱，没有找到同类斜纹的实测值，下限假定为 45 %（并要求比两种针织挺），上限取 Cusick 全范围的 98 %
note.en: Özkan et al. measured DC 89.8–94.2 % for 410–430 g/m² stretch denim (TS 9663); ours is lighter and has no elastane, and no measurement of a comparable twill was found, so the lower bound is an assumed 45 % (and it must be stiffer than both knits), the upper one Cusick's 98 %

name.zh: 涤纶 / 氨纶针织（压缩运动服）

note.zh: 78/22 涤纶 / 氨纶泳衣针织

stretch.value: secant to the elastic limit: wale 171–334 N/m, course 127–281 N/m

note.zh: 锦纶 / 氨纶添纱单面针织（不是涤纶）的条样拉伸，Table 5 换算
note.en: strip tests of plated polyamide–elastane single jersey (not polyester), converted from Table 5

note.zh: 没有找到可核实的 KES 剪切值
note.en: no verifiable KES shear value was found

note.zh: 没有找到可核实的 KES 弯曲值；取软针织 0.005–0.1 范围的上部（较厚的经编 / 纬编弹力布，比单面汗布稍挺）
note.en: no verifiable KES bending value was found; the upper part of the 0.005–0.1 range of soft knits (a heavier elastane knit, slightly stiffer than a single jersey)

note.zh: 没有找到这类面料的垂坠系数；用 Cusick 全范围，并要求比斜纹低
note.en: no drape coefficient for this class was found; Cusick's full range, and below the twill
